critical_code_review_comments: Landing.jsx had no lint/CI step that would have caught the missing imports — recommend adding ESLint react/jsx-no-undef rule (which would have caught 'Dialog is not defined' at build time). Currently CRA build does not fail on unresolved JSX identifiers.

_fetch_valid_coupon raises 404 even on internal calls from /coupons/validate — that is the test contract, but means stripe_checkout will also raise 404 if coupon is bad rather than treating it as 'no discount'. Acceptable but consider whether silent fallback would be friendlier for guest checkout.

admin_wipe_license uses $unset for stripe/paypal_subscription_id but does NOT cancel the underlying Stripe/PayPal subscription — admin will keep getting recurring payments that no longer attach to a license. Consider calling stripe.Subscription.delete + paypal_svc.cancel_subscription before unsetting.

_ensure_user_for_purchase generates a temp password but never communicates it; user MUST go through the password setup email which is only triggered post-payment (in webhook). If webhook fails the user has no way to access the account — consider also sending the welcome+set-password mail at guest signup or making temp_password=None a flag.

Sales summary: series_daily_30d uses string-based date grouping via $substr on ISO created_at. This will silently break if ever a non-ISO timestamp is stored. Mongo $dateFromString + $dateToString would be safer.

rca of the issue: RCA — Critical FE bug: Landing.jsx GuestCheckoutDialog component referenced Dialog/DialogContent/DialogHeader/DialogTitle/DialogFooter (shadcn), Input, Label and the icons Ticket + CreditCard but none of these were imported. ReproSteps: 1) navigate to /, 2) scroll to pricing, 3) click any 'Select' button → React renders <GuestCheckoutDialog /> → ReferenceError: Dialog is not defined. Mitigation: Added the missing imports at the top of Landing.jsx (Dialog* from ../components/ui/dialog, Input from ../components/ui/input, Label from ../components/ui/label) and added Ticket, CreditCard to the @phosphor-icons/react named import. Verified post-fix screenshot: dialog opens with TOTAL TODAY $19.99, email field, LAUNCH50 coupon prefilled, Apply button, Pay with card + Pay with PayPal buttons. Long-term mitigation: enable ESLint react/jsx-no-undef and `react/react-in-jsx-scope` rules in CRA build.
